pandas.DataFrame.head

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Get the first n rows or values. On GroupBy the limit applies within each group.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

  • Returns

Call syntax

Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
n
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 5		
      int
A positive integer returns that many leading rows. A negative integer excludes that many rows from the end.

    
Returns
Returns the selected rows as a DataFrame.
